description: RETRO-API (Daniel 2026-10-28; D-054): the store that receives each session's log and keeps it.

retro.max_file_bytes.description: Largest log the store keeps as bytes; a larger one is kept as its header alone (stored: pointer, the source path and the digest), never truncated. 50 MiB, GitHub's per-file warning size, so a later move of the store into a git ref stays possible (docs/units/RETRO-API/audit.md).

retro.motor_dir.description: Where the coordinator's motor records (sessions.log, claims*, tmux captures) live on A Torre's box; scripts/retro ingest reads the unit's records there and says so when the directory is not on the box. $TOWER_MOTOR_DIR overrides it for one run.

default.description: Claude Code writes a turnAttributionKey on the launch-prompt line of every transcript; its value is a UUID (a turn id, not a credential). gitleaks' generic-api-key matches it on the key name, so without this exception the store refuses every real transcript (docs/units/RETRO-API/audit.md A11). Only that key with a UUID-shaped value is excepted; the same value under any other key is still refused.

retro.scan_allowlist.description: Exceptions the retro store's secret scan adds on top of the repo's own gitleaks config (local-checks.gitleaks_config, unchanged): each regex is matched against a finding's match text (gitleaks regexTarget match). The repo-wide scan does not read this.
